_comment: Texture an EXISTING mesh with Hunyuan3D 2.1 TexGen. Separate from the shape pass on purpose: loading ShapeGen and TexGen in one graph exceeds 16GB VRAM, and splitting also means a failed texture never costs you the geometry, and that any generator's mesh can be textured. mesh_path is a CONTAINER path. The reference image should be the same concept the shape came from. create_pbr writes albedo + metallic + roughness. LICENCE: Tencent Hunyuan Community License excludes the EU, UK and South Korea - see README.md#licensing. MEMORY: 6 views at 512 is what fits. The graph shipped 8 at 768 while docs/guide/textures.md listed 6/512 as the defaults, so anyone who ran it without overrides OOM'd a 16GB card on a setting the documentation said they already had. Raise max_num_view only in multiples of 30 degrees - the model indexes its camera embedding by azim // 30 - and expect more views to cost time and to add more places for two painted views to disagree.
